verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry or usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a hosted inference platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never documents a telemetry or tracking opt-out, data-retention control, or zero-logging mode. US-only Serverless and regional data-residency deployments are adjacent compliance features, not an opt-out of usage tracking, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
